fields.options: Attach the GoFrugal 3111 Sales Detail - Itemwise export (.xls or .xlsx), then click Preview (Dry Run) to check it, and Import (Create Drafts) to create the Sales Invoices. Invoices are created as Drafts for Finance to review and submit.

fields.label: Update Stock
fields.description: Leave OFF unless the outlet → warehouse mapping is confirmed. When ON, each line needs a mapped warehouse or the invoice is skipped.

fields.label: Naming Series (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to use the site default GST series. Set e.g. GST-2627.-.##### to pin it.
